dialogue_texts: You won't be making a sound once I blast you out of the sky.
I'm now laughing at you, pathetic humanoid magician.
If she were anything like you, she probably talked too much before getting beaten, too.
You defeated my twin sister without even guessing the truth!
Sorry, but I only take orders from myself. The Order sounds like a total drag anyway.
Now that I'm mad because you freed my princess...
Both you and Fusana will be cursed to serve the Order and me!
I will give you a special reward for defeating my twin sister, and you will love it.
Oho, a special reward? Unless it's a rare grimoire or some valuable magic items, I ain't interested!
My dear, sweet, beautiful sister will be avenged!
Revenge, is it? Sounds like the perfect excuse to show you my ultimate spark! Bring it on!
